title: Turn the enemy's scheme against them
next_chapter_hook: The moment the three reached consensus, a诡异 whisper emanated from the depths of the Tianji Record—a voice never before uttered by Mo Xiansheng: 'The plan is viable, but you have overlooked one thing...'

text.content: The agony erupted from his brow center like a tidal wave. Chen Ji felt his memories being forcibly torn apart by an invisible giant hand. Those schemes he believed he had hidden deeply, those chess pieces he had secretly plotted with Ye Qing, those fragments of the future he had purchased with his Heavenly Fate Value—all were laid bare before that domineering divine sense. 'Get out!' he roared. Within his Mental Sea, the tattered page of the Tianji Record blazed with blinding golden light, forcibly repelling that窥探 by a fraction. Cold sweat instantly soaked his back. Chen Ji clenched his teeth, using the searing pain to force himself to remain conscious—this divine sense's power was by no means something an ordinary strong cultivator could possess.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing, you must contact me within three breaths. The aura of the Tianji Record is being tracked. I need your Demonic Path mist.

text.content: The communication talisman dissolved into a wisp of black smoke vanishing into the horizon. Chen Ji forced himself upright, fingers rapidly forming seals, laying down triple soundproof barriers within a ten-zhang radius. His movements were swift yet orderly, each hand seal precise as if rehearsed a thousand times—this was instinct honed through countless narrow escapes from death. 'Mo Xiansheng,' he intoned within his Mental Sea, 'that divine sense just now... was it the本体 of the Heavenly Dao?' The Tianji Record quivered slightly. Mo Xiansheng's aged voice carried rare gravity: 'No, it is its eye. The Tianji Record has walked the world for a thousand years—it already views you as prey on its plate.'

dialogue.content: Half an hour later, a wisp of black mist silently penetrated Chen Ji's barrier. Ye Qing's figure emerged from within, her complexion even paler than usual—evidently she had强行赶来 using some secret technique. 'Are you insane? Contacting me at this critical moment?' She lowered her voice, tone carrying irritation, 'Though my Demonic Path mist can conceal the Tianji Record's aura, do you know that the Eye of the Heavenly Dao has been monitoring all communications of our Holy Sect?'

Chen Ji tugged at the corner of his mouth, revealing a weary yet shrewd smile: 'Precisely because it is always watching, we must make this show spectacular enough.' He retrieved a Jade Slip from his sleeve, gently pushing it toward Ye Qing, 'This is the new chess game I've drafted—feigned death.'

text.content: Ye Qing accepted the Jade Slip, her divine sense probing within. After a moment, her pupils contracted sharply: 'You intend to pretend being surrounded and killed by the three great sects... making the Eye of the Heavenly Dao believe you truly died?' Her voice trembled slightly, 'This is too risky. If it truly believes it, the moment of your 'death,' all causal threads of the Tianji Record will snap—at that time you will completely lose your ability to perceive the chess game.' Chen Ji leaned against the back of his chair, his gaze deep and distant: 'Which is why I need you. After I 'die,' I need you to continue controlling the half of the Demonic Path realm for me.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing fell silent for a long while. Complex emotions flickered within those bewitching purple eyes. 'You know what this means.' She finally spoke, her voice very soft, 'Handing the Demonic Path to me equals handing the accumulated luck of the Holy Sect for centuries into my palm. What if I...' Chen Ji interrupted her: 'Would you betray me?' He stared directly into her eyes, tone flat as if stating the weather, 'No, you wouldn't. Because what I can show you is far more than what the Holy Sect could ever give.'

choice.prompt: Chen Ji needs to make a critical decision in the upcoming plan, which will determine the foundation of trust for the three-person cooperation.

choices.text: Lay all cards on the table
choices.description: Reveal more details of the chess game rules to Ye Qing, including the true relationship between the Tianji Record and the Eye of the Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_cost: Expose more trump cards, weakening the information advantage
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing's trust significantly increases, plan execution becomes more harmonious
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may thus learn more truths, reducing future countermeasure space

dialogue.content: After hearing Chen Ji's complete plan, Ye Qing's purple eyes shimmered with complex light. 'You're insane,' she murmured, 'using the Eye of the Heavenly Dao as a chess piece... This is a crazy plan that even generations of prophets never dared to contemplate.' But the corner of her mouth lifted slightly, 'I love your madness.'

She extended her hand, a drop of purple essence blood凝聚ing at her fingertip, slowly falling into Chen Ji's palm. 'This is a strand of my primordial demonic energy. From now on, my life is staked on your boat.' Chen Ji grasped that drop of essence blood, expression complex: 'Aren't you afraid I'll sell you out?' Ye Qing chuckled lightly: 'A chess game that could drive you to this point must be spectacular enough to make me willingly enter the game.'

text.content: The moment the two reached consensus, a subtle fluctuation came from outside the barrier. Chen Ji's expression tensed. 'Someone's here.' Ye Qing's reaction was faster than his—a layer of Demonic Path mist instantly concealed both their auras. 'It's Su Qingyao.' Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, 'She arrived faster than I anticipated—it seems she has察觉到 something.'

choices.description: Only reveal the plan's framework, keeping the most core strategies in reserve as a backup
choices.visible_cost: Ye Qing may harbor doubts, future cooperation will have reservations
choices.visible_reward: Keep key trump cards, having more options when dealing with variables
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's incomplete understanding of the plan may cause deviations during execution

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pushed the Jade Slip back into his sleeve, his tone languid: 'You've seen the plan. Execution details will be discussed in detail three days later.' Ye Qing's brow furrowed slightly, clearly unsatisfied with this answer, but she didn't press. 'As expected, you still don't trust me.' She laughed softly, her tone revealing whether it was disappointment or admiration, 'But that's fine. I enjoy this feeling of maneuvering.'

text.content: At this moment, a cool spiritual energy fluctuation came from outside the barrier. Chen Ji and Ye Qing exchanged glances, both seeing surprise in the other's eyes. 'Su Qingyao?' Ye Qing's tone turned playful, 'The Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect personally coming to see a Servant Disciple like you? It seems this 'waste' persona of yours isn't working well in front of her.' Chen Ji ignored her teasing. With a light snap of his fingers, he withdrew a third of the barrier.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's figure appeared at the barrier's entrance. She remained in that cold and proud demeanor, her gaze sweeping across the room before settling on Ye Qing, a fierce killing intent flickering in her eyes. 'Demonic Path Saintess.' Her voice was cold as ice, 'Chen Ji, you better give me an explanation.'

Su Qingyao's voice was cold as ice from the depths of winter, her sword intent almost condensing into实体. 'Chen Ji, you think I don't know what you're doing?' She stepped closer with each word, each step carrying oppressive momentum, 'The Tianji Record's aura suddenly became disordered this morning, yet you—a Servant Disciple—remained perfectly safe under such circumstances. You think I'm blind?'

Chen Ji looked at her, the corner of his mouth lifting slightly. 'Since Su Senior Sister already knows everything, I won't pretend anymore.' He stood up, expression composed, 'Yes, I possess the Tianji Record Fragment. And yes, I know all its secrets.' Ye Qing's pupils contracted slightly, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to be so direct. Su Qingyao also froze for a moment, then coldly laughed: 'You are quite frank. Then let me ask you—' Her sword tip pressed against Chen Ji's throat, 'What exactly are you trying to do?'

text.content: Chen Ji did not dodge. He let that cold sword tip rest against his throat. He stared directly into Su Qingyao's eyes, each word clear: 'I want to live and leave this chess game.' His voice was soft, yet carried a desperate resolve, 'The Eye of the Heavenly Dao has already set its sights on me. If I continue following the prescribed path, in at most three months, I will become the latest piece to be sacrificed on its chessboard.' He paused, 'Which is why I need to feign death.'

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's attitude will determine whether she can become a participant in the plan. This is a critical game of strategy.

choices.description: Display the complete feigned death plan to Su Qingyao, inviting her to join as a third-party witness
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao may refuse or even report, exposing the plan to Tianqing Sect higher-ups
choices.visible_reward: Obtain cover from within the Tianqing Sect, three people working together to deceive the Eye of the Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's stance is not solid; bet that she will choose to believe you

dialogue.content: Chen Ji extended the Jade Slip containing the feigned death plan toward Su Qingyao. 'This is the greatest sincerity I can offer.' His voice was calm, 'If the plan fails, the Eye of the Heavenly Dao will wipe out all who know of it in the first instance—including you. But if you are willing to join, I can tell you a secret that not even Ye Qing knows.'

Su Qingyao did not take the Jade Slip. Her gaze moved between Chen Ji and Ye Qing before finally landing on Chen Ji's face. 'What secret?' Her voice remained cold and hard, but the sword tip had already moved a few inches away from Chen Ji's throat. Chen Ji smiled faintly, lowering his voice: 'I know where Chen Nian is.' These words were like a stone dropped into a still lake. Su Qingyao's pupils contracted violently—Chen Nian, that genius girl who had disappeared for years, was actually involved in this?

text.content: Ye Qing also revealed surprise. She had been cooperating with Chen Ji for months but had never heard him mention this name. 'Chen Nian...' she murmured, 'I've seen this name in the Holy Sect's archives.' Chen Ji nodded, his gaze profound: 'She is my sister, and also the key the Eye of the Heavenly Dao uses to suppress the Tianji Record. Finding her is the true decisive move of this chess game.'

choices.description: Only reveal the plan's framework to Su Qingyao, demanding she provide peripheral cover in her capacity as Inner Disciple of the Tianqing Sect
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao cannot deeply participate; the true intent of the plan may be misunderstood by her
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the plan's concealment; avoid Tianqing Sect higher-ups intervening too early
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may make incorrect judgments due to incomplete knowledge

dialogue.content: Chen Ji retracted the Jade Slip into his sleeve, expression languid: 'Su Senior Sister, I can tell you the general outline of the plan. But the specific execution details, I humbly cannot reveal for now.' Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly: 'Are you playing word games with me?' Chen Ji shook his head: 'No, these are the rules. The more one knows, the faster one dies.'

Ye Qing laughed aloud nearby: 'Su Chief, I actually think his frankness is already quite sufficient.' A playful glint flickered in her purple eyes, 'At least he didn't lie to you by saying this was just an ordinary trial mission, right?' Su Qingyao gave her a cold glance but said nothing. After a moment of silence, she finally spoke: 'Peripheral cover... I can do that. But you must give me a deadline.' Chen Ji nodded: 'Three months. Three months from now, regardless of success or failure, I will give you an answer.'

text.content: Thus, three people who should never have stood together finalized the framework of this great gamble within a简陋 barrier. Ye Qing was responsible for concealing the Tianji Record's aura with Demonic Path mist. Su Qingyao was responsible for drawing the Tianqing Sect's attention on the surface. And Chen Ji himself—as bait, to lure the Eye of the Heavenly Dao into the trap. The plan was simple, almost brutally so. But sometimes, the simplest chess game is反而 the hardest to破解.

The three-person meeting lasted a full two hours. When the last wisps of Demonic Path mist dissipated, twilight had settled outside the window. Chen Ji stood alone within the barrier, his gaze falling on the drop of purple essence blood in his palm. Ye Qing had left, but she had left behind words: 'The chess game has begun; once a piece is placed, there is no regret.' And before Su Qingyao departed, she had finally agreed to become a participant in the plan. 'Chen Ji.' She paused at the doorway without turning back, 'I don't know what you're scheming, but if it involves the Tianqing Sect... I will kill you with my own hands.'

Upon hearing this, the corner of Chen Ji's mouth curved into a faint smile. 'Su Senior Sister, you are indeed still the person I know.' His voice was soft, as if murmuring to himself, 'But rest assured, when I lay out strategies to manipulate the world, it is never to destroy anyone.' The door closed. Su Qingyao's footsteps faded into the distance. Chen Ji turned around, his gaze falling on the darkening sky beyond the window. Mo Xiansheng's voice arose in his Mental Sea, carrying a rare note of praise: 'Your layout is faster than I anticipated. However...' He paused, 'Have you considered what happens if Su Qingyao changes her mind within these three months?'

Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then gently shook his head. 'She won't.' His tone was certain, 'Because she wants to know what the old Patriarch of the Tianqing Sect is hiding more than anyone.' Mo Xiansheng said no more. The Tianji Record slowly turned, new content appearing on the yellowed pages—the next phase objective: locate Chen Nian and activate the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. 'Chen Nian...' Chen Ji murmured, a tender glint flickering in his eyes, 'Wait for me. This time, I absolutely will not let anyone take you away again.'

Night deepened. The Tianji Record's faint light flickered uncertainly in Chen Ji's palm. He closed his eyes, rapidly deducting every detail of the plan in his mind. Feigned death—must be sufficiently authentic to convince the Eye of the Heavenly Dao without doubt. Timing—must be on the day the three great sects jointly encircle the Demonic Path stronghold. Location—must be a battlefield with sufficient causal chaos... All conditions排列组合 in his mind. However, just as he was about to deduce the optimal solution, a诡异 whisper suddenly came from the depths of the Tianji Record. 'Something's wrong...' Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, his pupils reflecting the flickering candlelight, 'There's one more thing I've overlooked.'

He lowered his gaze to his chest—a black thread, barely visible to the naked eye, was slowly spreading there. That was the mark of Heavenly Fate backlash; every use of the Tianji Record's abilities deepened it. 'Mo Xiansheng.' Chen Ji's voice grew heavy, 'If I consume too much Heavenly Fate Value before the feigned death... can the plan still succeed?' Silence filled his Mental Sea for a moment. Then Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out, carrying rare gravity: 'This is precisely what I have been worrying about. Feigning death requires deceiving not just the Eye of the Heavenly Dao, but also the Tianji Record's own causal judgment. And the Heavenly Fate backlash on your body... is already approaching that red line.' Chen Ji closed his eyes. When he opened them again, his gaze held only determination. 'I understand.' he said, 'Then let this show begin from now.'
